title: Rams All-Pro cornerback and punt returner LeRoy Irvin dies at 68

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams All-Pro cornerback and punt returner LeRoy Irvin dies at 68
sources.description: LeRoy Irvin, a first-team All-Pro at both cornerback and punt returner with the Rams in the 1980s, has died at the age of 68.
